title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics; parity fixes & version bump v1.23.0
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR unifies auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics (consistent iterator/async iterator semantics), applies parity fixes between language SDKs, and updates package versions to v1.23.0. Motivation: downstream teams need consistent error handling and streaming ergonomics to simplify multi-language integrations and reduce customer confusion. What changed: consolidated retry/backoff strategy behind a shared spec, added automatic token refresh hooks, standardized streaming client interfaces (sync iterator + async iterator + tokenized chunk callbacks), aligned TypeScript and Go method names with Python ergonomics, fixed several parity gaps in default header handling and request metadata, updated changelogs and bumped package versions. Testing: added integration tests for auth refresh under 401->200 flows, streaming end-of-stream semantics, and retries under transient 5xx conditions. Migration notes: existing SDK consumers will need to update constructor options when using custom retry/backoff hooks; backward-compatible shims are provided for 2 release cycles. Related Linear tasks: ENG-2345 (unify SDK retries), ENG-2378 (streaming ergonomics).
